name: Oberweiler Foundation environment grants
summary: Illinois-based foundation funding nonprofits that protect wilderness and wetlands from exploitation or encroachment, such as native habitat restoration and stewardship. Applicants first send a two-page letter of proposal and are invited to a full application.
reporting: Grantees send quarterly progress reports under a signed grants contract.

applicant_types.quote: Be a 501(c)(3) tax exempt organization and be recognized as such by the U.S. Internal Revenue Service

access.quote: The Foundation requests a letter of proposal describing the proposed project.

reporting.quote: Sign a grants contract and agree to provide quarterly progress reports

effort.quote: Letters of Proposal may not exceed two typed pages
Formal grant applications are only accepted if invited after the Proposal Review.

geography.quote: Preventing the demise of America's wilderness/wetlands as a result of private exploitation and/or public encroachment
